description: Read and parse a dossier file. Returns metadata and content. Should be called AFTER verify_dossier passes.

dry_run.description: Also return dry_run_plan: a STATIC preview (files, commands, network, env, risk_score 0-100) derived from the dossier's declared metadata and code blocks. The executing agent may take other actions; the score is a heuristic, not a safety guarantee.

name: read_dossier
